title: Ordered pro-etale affine integration
statement:
In the finite coordinates for $\ell,E,n,A$, let $T$ be Noetherian with $\ell$ invertible and let $r\geq0$ satisfy $\ell^{r+1}A=0$. The infinity section of $\mathbf P^1_T$ is an effective Cartier divisor. Define one affine-line left functor as exact extension by zero along its standard chart followed by proper derived direct image. Restrict the normalized projective counit by the actual open-extension counit, using the canonical right-object pullback comparison. Define the ordered left tower by composition; define its counit recursively by the composite-counit formula, with the identity at rank zero. Its ordinary Tate right objects remain bounded below for any bounded-below input. Define the tower site comparison recursively from proper-mate/open-extension comparisons. This identifies sources only. The ordered integration is the inverse source comparison followed by the independent tower counit at the constant object. On a vector-bundle frame, prefix this map by the canonical inverse-frame exchange and Tate/compact-support composition comparisons; this defines the local integration.

The ordinary bundle compact-support, adjunction, twisted-pullback and projection coordinates are those of [def-pur-vector-integration-adjunction-arrows].

proof.text: For rightTower_plus, exact inverse image preserves bounded below objects via leftDerivedUpperStarIsoMapDerivedCategory and mapDerivedCategoryPlus. On each projective line, finite_etale_torsion_twist_line gives flatness of the degree-zero finite Tate line over the actual coefficient ring. The existing FlatModel torAmplitudeIn_singleFunctor_obj_of_flat gives amplitude [0,0]; isGE_tensor_of_torAmplitudeIn preserves a lower bound on the pulled-back arbitrary D+ input. Commute the degree-two shift with tensor and use the braiding for the right-tensor convention. The resulting bound is lowered by two. Restrict to the affine chart and induct on the coordinate tower, pulling invertibility to each stage. Dimension zero is exactly the input object.

For existsUniqueTowerCounit, implement the orderedCounit formula directly by dependent Nat.rec on the pro-etale derived categories at the tower stages, their lineLeft functors, and the compared ordinary right-tower objects. At each stage apply the actual lineCounit to the bounded-below object furnished by rightTower_plus. The defining equations of Nat.rec give exactly the zero and successor equations, with the successor right object identified by the defining affineTraceRightTower recursion. If another family satisfies the equations, convert HEq to equality at each degree and induct: zero is the identity, and the successor follows by composing the common line-counit image with the equal preceding values. Function extensionality proves equality of families.

The existing towerCounit chooses from this now-proved unique family. Keep the source-only recursive proper/open towerSiteComparison and define orderedIntegration by its inverse followed by that actual tower counit, exactly as in the existing definitions. No counit is chosen through comparison with ordinary integration, and all original public constructions are unchanged.

lean.statement: def orderedIntegration (T : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian T] (hT : IsUnit (l : Γ(T, ⊤))) (r : ℕ) (hA : ((l ^ (r + 1) : ℕ) : Scheme.finiteTateCoefficient l E n) = 0) (d : ℕ) : (comparison (Scheme.finiteTateCoefficient l E n) T).obj ((Etale.affineTraceLeft _ T d).obj ((Etale.affineTraceRight _ (l ^ (r + 1)) hA T d).obj (Etale.ordinaryFiniteUnit _ T))) ⟶ unit (Scheme.finiteTateCoefficient l E n) T
